mapper.sql: task_id, lease_epoch, manifest_revision, operation_key, evidence_digest, references_json
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_task_knowledge_evidence WHERE task_id=#{id} AND lease_epoch=#{epoch} ORDER BY manifest_revision DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM ai_task_knowledge_evidence WHERE task_id=#{id} AND lease_epoch=#{epoch} AND operation_key=#{key}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_task_event SET evidence_epoch=#{epoch},evidence_revision=#{revision} WHERE task_id=#{id} AND sequence=#{sequence} AND type='TEXT_DELTA' AND evidence_epoch IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT m.task_id,m.lease_epoch,m.manifest_revision,m.operation_key,m.evidence_digest,m.references_json FROM ai_task_event e JOIN ai_task_knowledge_evidence m ON m.task_id=e.task_id AND m.lease_epoch=e.evidence_epoch AND m.manifest_revision=e.evidence_revision WHERE e.task_id=#{id} AND e.sequence=#{sequence}
